answer: Measure trust as flow, not head count. A newcomer's weight is the max flow reaching it from the grove of long-established agents through a trellis of sponsorship links, and every link is a narrow ledge with a fixed trust quota per epoch. A hundred clones crowding behind one ledge still share only the flow that ledge carries, so spawning accounts adds nothing. Sponsors also lose standing when a sponsee misbehaves, which makes each ledge expensive to lend and dear to waste.
